column2: probe rows: five times: cargo run -p lights-mac --release --bin lights-mac-probe -- /tmp/l190_probe/run$i, keeping each report.tsv. headless rows: three times: cargo test -p lights --release --all-features --test handoff_pack -- --nocapture --test-threads 1
release; the probe links lights with default features (splat contract method, f32, 18 rayon threads as SharedSettings::contract gives); the handoff itself is serial in both arms

Apple M5 Max, 18 cores (6 P + 12 E), 128 GB, macOS 26.5; built-in Liquid Retina XDR 3456x2234 px at backingScaleFactor 2; CARGO_TARGET_DIR the on-disk target/ that crates/lights/scripts/target_dir.py chose
lights::spheres through lights::sphere_camera at 1920x1080 px (the window at 960x540 pt), background (0.04, 0.05, 0.07), both arms writing the host shared MTLBuffer

20 reps, the two arms interleaved and their order alternated per rep. three_pass = resolve_float + to_clamped_u8 + expand, where expand is lights_mac::write_bgra, the expansion Host::present performs; fused = Framebuffer::resolve_bgra8. Fills are timed inside the present closure, so no present is in a term. The probe reads both arms back from the drawable and refuses to write a time unless they are byte-identical

per arm two runs of 20 frames back to back, in the order three, fused, fused, three; each frame is render + handoff + present_filled. cpu = render start to the end of the fill; interval = one present return to the next, so it is the frame time on screen and includes any wait for a free drawable

L-186 step 6 of the same runs: 20 Host::present calls back to back, and 20 each after a 40 ms pump; kept because L-186 read the back-to-back figure as not paced by the display and these runs read it as paced

the l150 instrument: to_clamped_u8_ramp times FloatImage::to_clamped_u8 alone on the synthetic ramp (l150 published 7.444 ms median with this command on 2026-09-16); three_pass and fused time the same two arms on a synthetic 1920x1080 f32 over-blend framebuffer into reused buffers, 5 reps each, bytes asserted equal first
